messages:
anna_support: @julia_customer saw your note about the invoice jump, digging in now — can you confirm this is for the private VPC deployment (cluster vpc-prod-1)?
julia_customer: yep — vpc-prod-1. Billing dashboard shows a 3x token increase starting yesterday 03:20 UTC. Audit logs show normal request counts though. :confused:
mike_sre: quick check — did the customer enable any batch-replay or agent maintenance around that time? offline buffering can cause replay duplicates if ordering gets corrupted.
anna_support: customer says they did a windowed replay after a short outage, but they only replayed events from the buffer, no manual re-ingest.
liam_eng: can we see agent logs for the replay window? please paste tail with timestamps around 2026-03-08T03:00->03:40Z. `journalctl -u redwood-meter -o short-iso --since "2026-03-08 03:00" --until "2026-03-08 03:40"`
julia_customer: attaching excerpt (redacted):
```
Mar 08 03:18:12 meter-agent[2345]: buffer: replay start seq=120045 count=245
Mar 08 03:18:12 meter-agent[2345]: upload: chunk=1/3 commit_id=abc123
Mar 08 03:18:14 meter-agent[2345]: error: temporary S3 timeout, marking chunk pending
Mar 08 03:18:16 meter-agent[2345]: buffer: replay restart seq=120045 count=245
Mar 08 03:18:17 meter-agent[2345]: upload: chunk=1/3 commit_id=abc123
Mar 08 03:18:17 meter-agent[2345]: success: commit_id=abc123
```

mike_sre: hmm looks like the agent retried the same chunk and eventually succeeded — if our ingestion path doesn't dedupe by commit_id/request_id, double-count could happen. Need to check sequence handling on the collector.
liam_eng: collector maintains per-tenant sequence but we also rely on request_id dedupe at post-processing. Can you run a quick query against internal-meter-audit for that tenant for seq range 120000-120300? `select seq, request_id, token_count from meter_events where tenant_id='tenant_42' and seq between 120000 and 120300 order by seq;`
anna_support: ran it, results show duplicate seq entries for seq=120045 (two rows, different event_id), token_count doubled for those specific rows.
julia_customer: so that explains invoice delta? dashboard aggregates by request_id and dedupes, invoices count raw ingested events? i thought invoices use the same pipeline.
nish_billing: invoices are generated from the billing-meter table which consumes the ingestion topic. If duplicates made it into the topic, billing will count them unless dedupe step runs. We may need to reconcile and apply credits.
metering-bot: Incident runbook match: metering.replay-duplicates.v1 — suggested immediate action: pause replay, mark buffer as quarantined, collect logs, and run dedupe script.
mike_sre: immediate mitigation for customer: ask them to stop agent replay and set `REDWOOD_METER_REPLAY_STRICT=true` to enable strict idempotency (hotfix). Also rotate the upload commit ids to avoid reusing same commit_id for retries until we patch.
liam_eng: created a quick fix on collector: treat (tenant_id, commit_id) as idempotency key for ingestion while we do a proper dedupe job. Pushing a canary to collector cluster now.
anna_support: customer applied `REDWOOD_METER_REPLAY_STRICT=true` and paused agent at 03:22 UTC. Can we confirm no new duplicates after pause?
liam_eng: canary shows no new duplicate seqs after 03:22. Also found an ordering edge: agent replay can re-send same seq range with slight timestamp regression due to NTP skew; collector used event timestamp for partitioning which let duplicates slip into a different window. We will change to use monotonic seq for partitioning.
julia_customer: thanks — long term what's the plan and ETA for credits? need an expected impact figure to pass to finance.
nish_billing: we'll calculate overcount = sum(duplicated_token_count) for affected window and propose a credit entry for the invoice. Please give us the full seq ranges and tenant IDs.
liam_eng: follow-ups: 1) patch collector idempotency (in progress, PR #4827), 2) deploy partitioning fix (next week), 3) add agent safeguard to avoid reusing commit_id across retries (hotfix ready), 4) add observability: replay/audit drift alert.
mike_sre: repro steps for engineering: 1) simulate transient upload failure during chunk commit, 2) agent retries and replays buffer using same commit_id, 3) collector accepts both due to timestamp partition variance. I've put simulation script in the ticket.
anna_support: action items for support: collect full agent logs, buffer archive, and provide start/end seq ranges to billing. I'll send checklist to @julia_customer.
julia_customer: uploaded full log tarball and buffer manifest to support S3 path; confirmed no other maintenance windows. Appreciate the quick triage. :pray:
liam_eng: assigning follow-up bug and linking to internal postmortem. We'll also propose an immediate credit for the visible overcharge and send an updated invoice.
nish_billing: noted. Will hold off billing adjustments until we have final overcount numbers but will prepare provisional credit.
anna_support: closing loop for now — will update this thread once collector patch is live and credits are computed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
